description.value: Tealips Cafe is a bubble tea and dessert café serving Burnaby's Highgate neighbourhood with a broad menu of milk teas, fruit slushes, coffee drinks, Korean-style bingsoo, Belgian waffles, and fresh focaccia sandwiches. The café operates under a shared brand with a second Burnaby location (Metrotown/Arcola Way) and supports online ordering with in-store pickup. Cyclists will find a wide range of cold and hot drinks, light meals, and vegetarian-friendly options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Tealips Cafe is an active bubble tea and dessert café; the order page explicitly lists 'Pickup from 110-6125 Sussex Ave,' corroborating the OSM address as the Highgate location, while the homepage shows a separate address (7139 Arcola Way) indicating two locations exist. OSM tags for a changing table in a unisex toilet confirm washrooms on-site; the website does not mention bike parking, Wi-Fi, or water refills. The OSM name:en tag ('Mr. Mustache Tea & Dessert') conflicts with the current operating name and the Wi-Fi SSID 'Mustache-guest' suggests a rebrand.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM and order page list 6125-110 Sussex Avenue (Highgate), but website homepage prominently shows 7139 Arcola Way, Burnaby BC V5E 0A6 as the main contact address. This is a two-location business; the OSM record corresponds to the Highgate location only.

Phone number (778) 397-3972 is listed on the website alongside the Arcola Way address; it is unclear whether this number serves both locations or only the Metrotown/Arcola Way location. OSM had no phone to compare.

OSM name:en is 'Mr. Mustache Tea & Dessert,' conflicting with the current operating name 'Tealips Cafe' used throughout the website. The Wi-Fi SSID 'Mustache-guest' further suggests the business rebranded from Mr. Mustache Tea & Dessert to Tealips.
Website URL was auto-discovered with medium confidence and is not present in OSM tags; should be verified as the official site for this specific Sussex Ave location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating café with a live website, online ordering, and confirmed pickup at the Sussex Ave location.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two Burnaby locations confirmed: Highgate at 6125-110 Sussex Ave (this OSM record) and a second location at 7139 Arcola Way (Metrotown area). The rebrand from 'Mr. Mustache Tea & Dessert' to 'Tealips' appears complete based on website evidence; the OSM name:en tag should be updated.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Our avocado sandwich is a vegetarian favorite'; milk teas described as 'lactose free'; oat milk substitution available on tea lattes and smoothies

wow_evidence: shared brand with a second Burnaby location (Metrotown/Arcola Way)
